learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with skills in processing data, obtained from experiments in the field of engineering, which requires the use of: Probability theory mathematical apparatus, Mathematical statistics methods of experimental data processing, MATLAB in practice.

assessment_rules: The final course mark is formed on the basis of the following formula: Final course mark = 3/4 the grade of the test + 1/4 the grade of practical classes. Assessment is by continuous assessment and a written exam.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
